sections.title: Collection coverage
sections.sql: select * from collection_coverage order by code

sections.title: Overdue actions
sections.sql: select a.code,a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,d.external_id as document from overdue_actions a left join documents d on d.id=a.document_id order by a.due_on,a.code

sections.title: Content reviews
sections.sql: select external_id,title,owner,status,review_on from review_queue order by external_id

sections.title: Retention reviews
sections.sql: select external_id,title,owner,retention_review_on from retention_queue order by external_id

sections.title: Unanswered questions
sections.sql: select query,audience,count(*)::int as attempts from query_log where result_count=0 group by query,audience order by attempts desc

sections.title: Control findings
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,record
